scope: Synthetic, disposable PostgreSQL scenario with operations reviewer, assigned qualified team lead, receiving Supervisor, direct-report Technician, real VMMS API and browser work-plan/assigned-task UI.

checks.name: Accepted synthetic evidence is attached before Operations review and team-lead assignment
Accepted source file and structured report items are recorded with recorder attribution
Correction history remains readable and keeps the linked source file
Printable report shows selectable source text, recorder, file name and correction history
The G2 gate distinguishes diagnostic consent from repair, parts and added-cost authorization.
Toast notification stays available while focused and dismisses on request
Team-lead choices show staff names without internal qualification codes
Server validation errors on work-order forms are linked to their matching control
Reception observation server errors are linked to their matching field
Evidence upload errors are announced and described by the file picker
Work-order form close and diagnostic observation add/remove preserve focus and announce changes through live status regions
Authorized Operations user records current review and qualified lead assignment through the real browser UI; persisted detail preserves reviewer, notes, lead and reason
Selecting a prior paying client in intake returns focus to its summary and announces the selection
Server validation errors appear beside the matching intake field with invalid state and a description association
Desktop rail collapse, independent workspace scrolling, and compact navigation toggle keep account controls available
Job filter and intake action use plain-language labels
Workshop Service Report passes automated WCAG 2.1 A/AA checks before print
Work-order summary PDF keeps selectable report fields, excludes application chrome, and paginates long text across 11 pages
Purpose-built workshop service report prints its recorded details while excluding the workspace and report controls
Supervisor assignment is gated until the current assigned lead saves a plan
Response-loss simulation confirms the first browser request committed once while the form retained its values
Stale plan save explains the conflict, keeps entries and succeeds after the current version loads
Retry reuses the original idempotency key and body; committed revision and work-order version remain unchanged
Reloading the real work-order page restores the saved rationale and reordered task sequence
Assigned Technician records a task progress update through the page and reads it back from the scoped API
Assigned Technician can start, recover and stop a server-timed task session without changing task state
Task time controls start and stop by keyboard, announce stale errors, pass automated WCAG checks and fit phone, foldable, tablet and desktop widths

limitations: Physical-device, production role schedule, SOP and management approval remain untested.
This draft does not authorize repairs or satisfy G2.
